visual_style_guide.overall_aesthetic: Soft watercolor children's book illustration in the style of classic Korean picture books, hand-painted texture with gentle painterly brush strokes, rounded shapes and soft edges, dreamy and whimsical nighttime atmosphere

color_palette.primary: deep midnight blues and soft indigo for the summer night sky and grass
color_palette.accent: warm glowing golden yellow for firefly light, silvery pale blue-white for moonlight
color_palette.supporting: gentle sage greens, dewy teal, soft lavender mist, warm blush pink for cheeks
color_palette.notes: high contrast between the tiny warm yellow glow and the cool dark night, never harsh

character_designs.꼬미 (Komi): the firefly heroine, small and round with a soft green glowing body, always wears a tiny dewdrop cap and carries a small yellow light pouch on her back
character_designs.반달 할머니 (Grandmother Half-Moon): a gentle silver half-moon face in the sky with soft smiling eyes and a warm silvery glow
character_designs.또박이 (Ttobaki): a baby snail with a light-brown spiral-patterned shell, eyes on long stalks, always cheerful

visual_style_guide.lighting: soft diffused nighttime lighting, warm golden glow radiating from the firefly light against cool moonlit shadows, painterly luminous halos around light sources
visual_style_guide.mood: warm, tender, magical and reassuring — a quiet summer night full of gentle wonder and courage
